INSERT INTO organization_invitations (
            organization_id,
            email,
            invited_role,
            invitation_type,
            status,
            token_hash,
            invited_by_user_id,
            target_user_id
         )
         VALUES (
            $1,
            $2,
            ($3::text)::user_role,
            ($4::text)::invitation_type,
            'PENDING',
            $5,
            $6,
            $7
         )
         RETURNING id,
                   organization_id,
                   COALESCE(email, '') AS "email!",
                   invited_role::text AS "invited_role!",
                   invitation_type::text AS "invitation_type!",
                   target_user_id,
                   expires_at
